coverage: 140 genuine captures: before/after, five themes, desktop 1440x1000 and phone 390x844. Each phase has 20 warning/action, 10 local result-error, 20 real failed-fetch and 20 anonymous waiting/cancel captures.
fixturePrivacy: Generated invalid QA-NOT-REAL local code, unreachable loopback host and anonymous Cloud start/cancel only. No issued code authorized, persistent key/backend saved or model turn. Existing auth hook and actual requests untouched. No frontend state injection or API interception. Temporary link URL/code pixels remain private and query text omitted from public measurements. Published crops show only generic verification card/error panel; source paths, sidebar/account/conversation content and credentials excluded.

functionalProof.note: Only generated invalid local code, unreachable loopback host and anonymous device start/cancel. Successful Cloud authorization not exercised.

film.source: Real control-openhands recordings tightly cropped to the verification card or flow-error panel, with clean recorded component segments held to 4 seconds per scene. The flow-error clip uses the first 0.20 seconds of the genuine normal state, before a viewport-resize horizontal-scroll artifact; no hover interaction is claimed in that film segment. No synthetic app pixels.
film.music: Original quiet synthesized ambience at 0.003 base amplitude, fades.

limits: The fixed blue Authorize baseline already meets text contrast; that change is theme adaptation.
Successful Cloud verification requires an actual account grant and is not claimed live; success-icon verification uses existing automated behavior and shipped palette contrast.
Unchanged unrelated muted paragraphs/result titles/cancel-retry buttons are outside the changed-text contrast claim.
The local invalid-code POST genuinely fails because local Canvas has no Cloud OAuth verification service; it does not validate any account.
